policies.title: Barbadian regular-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Barbados reserves its regular passport to citizens, and its Immigration Act expressly gives citizens the right to enter Barbados.
conditions: Applies to a Barbadian citizen holding a valid regular passport; official, diplomatic and emergency documents are outside this rule, and lawful border controls remain.

policies.title: Guyanese passport citizenship
policies.summary: Guyana limits national-passport eligibility to Guyanese citizens and exempts citizens from a home-entry visa even when documented by a foreign passport.
conditions: Applies to a Guyanese citizen holding a valid standard Guyana passport; identity evidence and ordinary lawful border controls remain.

policies.title: Grenadian passport citizenship
policies.summary: Grenada's prescribed passport form requires Grenadian citizenship, while the Constitution protects entry and identifies non-citizens as a distinct restriction class.
conditions: Applies to a Grenadian citizen holding a valid Caribbean Community Grenada passport; special documents and lawful border controls remain outside the classification.

policies.title: Saint Lucian national-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Saint Lucia's national-passport service requires citizenship evidence, while the Constitution protects entry and distinguishes non-citizens.
conditions: Applies to a Saint Lucian citizen holding a valid machine-readable national passport; emergency and identity certificates are outside this rule.

policies.title: Cambodian citizen return
policies.summary: Cambodia's Constitution directly gives Khmer citizens the right to return to Cambodia.
conditions: Applies to a Khmer citizen holding a valid standard Cambodian passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Kyrgyz general-civil passport citizenship
policies.summary: Kyrgyzstan's current service standard limits the general-civil passport to citizens of the Kyrgyz Republic.
conditions: Applies to a Kyrgyz citizen holding a valid general-civil passport; diplomatic, service and other special documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Lao ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Laos's official state submission records the citizen right to hold a passport and enter or leave Laos, corroborated by the current ordinary e-passport service.
conditions: Applies to a Lao citizen holding a valid ordinary e-passport; diplomatic, service and other special documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Nepali regular-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Nepal's Passport Department requires original Nepali citizenship evidence for an ordinary e-passport and distinguishes regular from official and diplomatic passports.
conditions: Applies to a Nepali citizen holding a valid regular e-passport; official, diplomatic and other special documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Syrian passport citizenship
policies.summary: Syria's Interior Ministry identifies the passport as a constitutional citizen right and states that it is supplied to citizens.
conditions: Applies to a Syrian citizen holding a valid standard passport; emergency, special and other travel documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Yemeni ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Yemen's passport law reserves ordinary passports to Yemeni nationals and expressly protects their right to leave and return.
conditions: Applies to a Yemeni national holding a valid ordinary passport; emergency, pilgrimage, seafarer, diplomatic and special documents are outside this rule.
